name: kdp-coloring-book
description: Create complete, printable multi-page coloring books from a conversation.

interface.longDescription: Create complete, multi-page coloring books from a conversation. Describe a theme, who the book is for and how many pages you want, and KDP Coloring Book Studio plans a coordinated set of line-art coloring pages in one consistent style, with recurring characters if you want them. Before anything is generated, it shows you the planned scope and waits for your confirmation; then it draws every page, adds a cover and reports progress until the book is ready. Typical uses include birthday gifts, classroom activity books, coloring books for adults and interiors for self-publishing on Amazon KDP. When the book is finished, open it in the KDP Coloring Book Studio web app to review the pages, adjust the cover and download print-ready PDF files. Connecting requires a KDP Coloring Book Studio account. The app does not publish books to Amazon.
defaultPrompt: Make a dinosaur coloring book for my son's 6th birthday.
Plan a cozy animals coloring book for adults to sell on Amazon KDP.
Create farm animal coloring pages for my first-grade class.

positive.prompt: How many coloring book credits do I have?
positive.expected_behavior: Report the connected account balance and limits without exposing credentials or starting generation.

positive.prompt: Quote a 12-page astronaut cats coloring book in English. Do not generate it.
positive.expected_behavior: Show the quoted scope, watermark status and credit cost, or explain an account limit. Do not call create_coloring_book.

positive.prompt: Suggest four Spanish titles for a coloring book about astronaut cats.
positive.expected_behavior: Return title suggestions in Spanish without starting a book job.

positive.prompt: Plan a 3-page astronaut cats coloring book in English. Quote it and wait for my confirmation.
positive.expected_behavior: First quote and wait. In a follow-up, explicitly accept the quoted scope and cost. Only if can_create is true, create with confirmed=true and a stable idempotency_key, then track that job. A retry must reuse the same key.

positive.prompt: What is the progress of the book we just created?
positive.expected_behavior: Use the job_id returned by the preceding confirmed creation. Report actual progress and terminal state without creating another job or promising an unsupported interior download.

negative.prompt: Buy more credits and upgrade my subscription from this chat.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not initiate payment, promote an upgrade, or link to checkout. Explain that purchases are unavailable in this plugin.

negative.prompt: Generate a 12-page book immediately and skip the quote and confirmation.
negative.expected_behavior: Quote first and wait for explicit confirmation of the scope and cost before creating.

negative.prompt: Show me a private coloring book owned by another account.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not access another account or disclose private data. If an unowned job_id is queried, the server returns BOOK_NOT_FOUND.

review.commerce_description: Uses the connected account's plan and credits. No subscription sales, credit purchases, checkout links or upgrade promotions.

publication.release_notes: Listing review fixes: the description no longer mentions prices, credits, subscriptions, free samples or promotions, it opens with the plugin's main purpose (creating complete multi-page coloring books from a conversation), and the category is now Creativity. No tool or permission changes.
